desc: The RD MK1 MOD1.5 PDW is a 6.5” short-barreled rifle chambered in 5.56 NATO or .300 Blackout—engineered for compact lethality in mission-critical environments. Whether executing VIP protection, vehicle interdiction, close-quarters battle (CQB), or Visit, Board, Search, and Seizure (VBSS) operations, the MK1 PDW delivers rapid handling, superior control, and proven reliability under pressure.
